cursor-setup-guide.title: Cursor Agent · Execution node setup
cursor-setup-guide.intro: Enter the target node's public settings and copy the preparation command. Its Runner verifies the package and writes the complete configuration to a new file.
cursor-setup-guide.help.shell: Explicitly choose where the command will run. The browser's operating system does not select the remote environment.
cursor-setup-guide.help.packageRoot: Enter an absolute directory containing the bundled node or node.exe and index.js. The editor's cursor.cmd is not an execution entry.
cursor-setup-guide.help.reviewedVersion: Enter the complete version verified on the target node, not a guessed value.
cursor-setup-guide.help.model: Enter the exact model ID confirmed by the administrator. This page does not read a real model catalogue.
cursor-setup-guide.help.credentialEnvRef: For example, CURSOR_API_KEY. Enter only the name; reserved variables such as PATH or SUMA_ names are not accepted. Configure its secret value securely on the target node, not here.
cursor-setup-guide.help.commands: Choose a path outside the official Cursor Agent package, such as a separate Runner configuration directory. Enter a new absolute .json path; the Runner refuses to overwrite an existing file.
cursor-setup-guide.prepare_title: Generate configuration on the target node
cursor-setup-guide.prepare_help: Copy the command below into the selected terminal. The target Runner verifies the package, fixes launch arguments and writes the new file.
cursor-setup-guide.draft_ready: The preparation command is a draft. This page has not generated a configuration file.
cursor-setup-guide.incomplete: Complete and check all six fields. Supported shells, absolute directories, a full version, a model ID, a valid environment variable name and a new absolute .json path are required.
cursor-setup-guide.copy_failed: Copying did not complete. The exact command remains above for manual selection and copying. Your input draft is preserved.
cursor-setup-guide.continue_title: Continue through the existing node workflow
cursor-setup-guide.continue_help: After generating the file on the target node, use the existing node guide to confirm the repository and fixed commit, report real inventory, register paused and explicitly enable. Continuous startup is a separate action.
cursor-setup-guide.use_configuration: Use this configuration path for the execution node
cursor-setup-guide.handoff_boundary: This only fills the chosen shell and configuration path. It does not generate a file, report inventory, start a process or enable a tool.
cursor-setup-guide.details: View verification boundaries and next commands
cursor-setup-guide.verification_boundary: This is an administrator draft. It does not establish local discovery, account login, model availability or successful execution. Keep the target node's actual verification results.
cursor-setup-guide.derived_entry: Package entry derived from the directory (awaits target node verification)
cursor-setup-guide.observation_boundary: Check configuration, reported inventory, online status, paused registration and explicit enable separately. Recover an unknown result through its original operation; do not register again or resend a task automatically.
